items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: Him and Charlie Schaefer says Session one night down on 7th Avenue He ran us out about five joints there one night

ctx.x: It's a true blue blue He came for an all day, he gave him home and he saw It's more eternal You know I am? Who played first trumpet you said? Me Who? I did Al He had a great man from the fire to get a bottle of love Love for a girl, the only sight, who shared in my heart, gone by In later years he went with Oiskin Hawkins Trying to sing him Baby from dying in heaven's heart There's a reward for that final song He just won't play in heart Play for the main hall Of the road To the road Billy Douglas Billy Douglas…
We have a bass player that's on that record Jimmy Johnson Used to be with Buddy Bole and all of that What kind of style of bass did he play usually?
